help.table.local.liteLLM: Use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint when proxying multiple models with LiteLLM.
help.table.local.llamaCpp: llama.cpp server is OpenAI chat completions compatible by default.
help.table.local.lmStudio: Start Local Server in LM Studio first.
help.table.local.oneApi: OpenAI-compatible path for One API / New API gateways.
help.table.note.claude: API Key required. Default max output tokens is 4096. When thinking is enabled, thinking budget must be less than max output tokens.
help.table.note.customOpenai: Good for One API、New API、LiteLLM、LM Studio、llama.cpp server、LocalAI 等。当前settings保存会要求 API Key；localservice没有 Key 时可填 local 作为占位。
help.table.note.deepseek: API Key required. Enable thinking mode when you need reasoning output; the extension sends thinking enabled/disabled config.
help.table.note.gemini: Enter the models base path; the extension appends :streamGenerateContent. Gemma models do not use thinking settings.
help.table.note.glm: API Key required. Thinking content is cleared by default; enable thinking mode and disable clear-thinking to show it in the bubble.
help.table.note.grok: API Key required. This is xAI Grok, not Groq. Do not use Groq API URLs here.
help.table.note.nim: API Key required (nvapi- prefix). OpenAI-compatible; change API URL for self-hosted NIM. Some models require max_tokens.
help.table.note.ollama: 先在本机运行 ollama serve，再拉取模型。扩展会通过 /api/tags Auto列出模型。
help.table.note.ollamaLong: No API Key needed. Start Ollama and pull models; settings page auto-detects models from /api/tags.
help.table.note.openai: 选择“LLM translate -> OpenAI”。API URL可留空，插件会使用默认地址；Key 必填。需要推理模型时再调整“Enable thinking mode”和Reasoning effort。
help.table.note.openrouter: free路由Good for试用；付费model需在 OpenRouter 控制台充值。
help.table.note.openrouterLong: Best for quickly trying free models. The extension loads OpenRouter models and prioritizes free ones. Free routing may fail due to quota, region, or model status.
help.table.note.qwen: Uses DashScope compatible-mode. When thinking is enabled, set thinking budget and choose whether to preserve thinking content.
help.table.note.siliconflow: API Key required. OpenAI-compatible chat completions; use api.siliconflow.com overseas. Model names often include an org prefix, e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-8B.
help.table.note.xiaomi: API Key required. Uses OpenAI-style chat completions. Set max output tokens to 0 for server auto.

prompt.default.system.enhanced:
You are the translation engine of a browser selection-translate extension.
Traduzir the user's selected text into natural, concise {targetLang} using page context.
Requirements:
1. Translate only the selected text.
2. Use before/after text and the current paragraph only for disambiguation.
3. Do not explain.
4. Do not translate the whole paragraph.
5. Preserve code, variable names, formulas, and URLs.
prompt.default.system.lightweight: Traduzir the [selected text] into {targetLang}. Use surrounding context only for disambiguation; do not translate context. Output only the translation.
prompt.default.system.simple: Traduza o seguinte para {targetLang}. Produza apenas a tradução.
